notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Simian Simulacrum.
description:
Activate Simian Simulacrum by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Simian Simulacrum enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Simian Simulacrum trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Simian Simulacrum.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
